reason: I already built my whole life in Notion: databases, relations, templates, the lot, and it already shares data between my notes, budget and gym log. I'd maybe poke at the free tier, but I'm not moving everything over and paying for a second system that does what mine already does.
objection: Nothing in the pitch says who can see my notes and receipts or whether I can export everything cleanly. If an assistant is reading my stuff and I can't get my data out in a normal format, that's a hard no.
would_change_my_mind: A one-tap Notion import plus a full export to Markdown/CSV, and a plain statement that my data isn't used to train anything. Then the snap-a-receipt and talk-to-log stuff might be worth $6 because Notion is clunky on my phone.
